description_en: Intelligently removes unwanted elements from e-commerce images by automatically identifying and erasing text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and promotional stickers. Supports specifying target objects for removal to enable efficient and accurate batch processing and simplify image editing
description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作
name: ImageRemoveAsync

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format. The resolution must be between 256 × 256 and 3000 × 3000 pixels, and the file size cannot exceed 10 MB
parameters.help_zh: 原图 URL，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至3000x3000像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The types of elements to remove from the image subject. Valid values:
1: Transparent text blocks.
2: Specific names.
3: Text.
4: Promotional stickers.
You can select multiple element types. This parameter is optional, but you must specify at least one of the following parameters: ObjectRemoveElements, NonObjectRemoveElements, Mask, Position, UserText, and UserImage.
If multiple parameters are specified, the priority is as follows: UserImage > UserText > Position > Mask > ObjectRemoveElements = NonObjectRemoveElements.
For more information about each type, see the product documentation.
Image subject: the core product area in the image
parameters.help_zh:
去除图片主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），元素类型可多选。非必填，但是ObjectRemoveElements、NonObjectRemoveElements、Mask、Position、UserText、UserImage几个元素需要至少填写一个。
当多个参数均填写时生效优先级：UserImage>UserText>Position>Mask>ObjectRemoveElements=NonObjectRemoveElements
各类型说明可见产品说明
图片主体：图片中的核心产品区域
parameters.name: object_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The list of element types to remove from the image background
parameters.help_zh: 需要去除的图片非主体元素类型列表
parameters.name: non_object_remove_elements

parameters.help_en:
The specific area to erase. This parameter must be used in conjunction with the editor. The input format is Run-Length Encoding (RLE).
If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence and the remove_non_product_area_elements and remove_product_area_elements parameters are ignored. This parameter is optional, but you must specify at least one of the following parameters: ObjectRemoveElements, NonObjectRemoveElements, Mask, Position, UserText, and UserImage.
If multiple parameters are specified, the priority is as follows: UserImage > UserText > Position > Mask > ObjectRemoveElements = NonObjectRemoveElements
parameters.help_zh:
具体的消除区域。需要配合编辑器使用，入参格式为 RLE。
若传入将优先使用，忽略remove_non_product_area_elements和
remove_product_area_elements这两个参数。非必填，但是ObjectRemoveElements、NonObjectRemoveElements、Mask、Position、UserText、UserImage几个元素需要至少填写一个。
当多个参数均填写时生效优先级：UserImage>UserText>Position>Mask>ObjectRemoveElements=NonObjectRemoveElements
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en:
The specific area to erase. This parameter must be used in conjunction with the editor. The input format is a four-point coordinate array, such as [xx,yy,zz,dd]. This parameter is optional, but you must specify at least one of the following parameters: ObjectRemoveElements, NonObjectRemoveElements, Mask, Position, UserText, and UserImage.
If multiple parameters are specified, the priority is as follows: UserImage > UserText > Position > Mask > ObjectRemoveElements = NonObjectRemoveElements
parameters.help_zh:
具体的消除区域。需要配合编辑器使用，入参格式为 四点坐标[xx,yy,zz,dd]。非必填，但是ObjectRemoveElements、NonObjectRemoveElements、Mask、Position、UserText、UserImage几个元素需要至少填写一个
当多个参数均填写时生效优先级：UserImage>UserText>Position>Mask>ObjectRemoveElements=NonObjectRemoveElements
parameters.name: position

parameters.help_en: The list of URLs for user-specified image elements to erase
parameters.help_zh: 用户指定的待消除图片元素链接列表
parameters.name: user_image

parameters.help_en: The list of user-specified text strings to erase
parameters.help_zh: 用户指定的待消除文本列表
parameters.name: user_text
